hands.anchored: Other nodes point at this one
hands.anchored_partial: Named below: {shown}. The count above is the complete one.
hands.anchored_scope: {n} of them lie outside your scope, so they are counted and never named.
hands.force_scope: force edits every pointing node, so every pointing node must be within your scope: with {n} outside it, the engine refuses the whole call.
hands.force_what: One commit removes this node and edits every node that points at it, dropping exactly the links whose target died — the forest is never left pointing at a hole.
hands.move_name_hint: Letters and digits. It becomes the file name.
hands.move_parent_hint: The branch it moves under. Only branches you can reach are listed.
hands.move_same: That is the address it already has.
hands.move_sub: A rename with a waymark: the document keeps everything it holds and gains a new address.
hands.move_waymark: The old address keeps answering: a read of {id} says where the document went, so anything already written down still leads to it.
hands.prune_git: The passport leaves the working tree through git, so the history keeps it: the commit records the removal, it does not erase what was written.
hands.prune_graveyard: A local payload — a dataset's .db, a media file — is moved to _derived/graveyard/, not deleted.
